verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a CLI developer tool, so versioning and deprecation of its interfaces is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no versioned API and no deprecation policy. It shows only a release version number (v8.28.0) and an upgrade note for gitleaks-action, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
